task_name: Geospatial levelized-cost model for African green hydrogen to Europe

named_methods.name: GeoH2 methodology (Halloran et al. 2024)
named_methods.description: Geospatial cost optimization of green hydrogen production including storage and transportation
key_components: LCOE calculation for PV and wind with spatial data
LCOH calculation with electrolysis CAPEX/OPEX, water costs, stack replacement

formulas.LCOE: LCOE = CAPEX/PVF + OPEX/E where PVF = ((1+i)^t - 1)/((1+i)^t * i)
formulas.LCOH: LCOH = (CAPEX + c_stack)/(PVF * FLH * eta_ely / w_H2) + OPEX/(FLH * eta_ely / w_H2) + LCOE*(w_H2/eta_ely) + c_H2O*v_H2O

named_methods.name: Ammonia-as-hydrogen-carrier pathway
named_methods.description: Green H2 converted to NH3 for shipping, then reconverted at import port

named_methods.name: Cost of capital framework (Steffen 2020; Schmidt et al. 2019)
named_methods.description: Financing cost scenarios affecting LCOE/LCOH competitiveness
scenarios: Base WACC 8% (from Müller et al. Kenya study)

named_methods.name: Shipping cost model (Johnston et al. via Müller et al.)
named_methods.description: Marine transport costs per kg H2 equivalent for ammonia carrier

target_quantities: LCOE (EUR/MWh) per hexagon for PV and wind
Delivered cost (EUR/kgH2) at European port via ammonia
Scenario comparisons: base, de-risked, rising rates, 2030 tech improvements
Europe vs Africa cost competitiveness gap
comparison_strata: Per-hexagon spatial variation across 30 African sites
